newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close at record high; banks, BAe advance.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close at record high; banks, BAe advance.

text.p: UK shares closed at a record high for the third time in five sessions on Friday, buoyed by firm U.S. Treasury bonds and lifted towards the close as the Dow recovered from early weakness.

Powered by gains in bank stocks, British Aerospace and Pearson, the FTSE 100 closed 11.0 points higher at 4,053.1, surpassing its previous record close of 4,050.8 set October 15. Gaining stocks outweighed decliners by some two-to-one.
Traders and fund managers said shares could continue higher as long as U.S. markets advance, despite recent strong UK economic figures suggesting a growing inflation risk.
